# plainslides

> Headless TypeScript library for HTML slide decks, built for AI agents. The library provides navigation, step reveals, slide transitions, scaling, a presenter window, timing, and modes. The author writes all markup and styles. A deck is one HTML file plus the IIFE build `plainslides.iife.js`, and it works from `file://` with no server and no network.

Read the agent guide before you build a deck. It contains the markup contract, keys, options, API, 20 recipes, and a checklist.

## Docs

- [Agent guide](docs/agent-guide.md): everything an agent needs to build a deck with plainslides.
- [README](README.md): overview, install, and development commands for people.

## Examples

- [Starter deck](examples/starter/index.html): a complete deck that shows every recipe. Copy the folder as a starting point.
- [Starter styles](examples/starter/example.css): commented example CSS for themes, recipes, step reveals, and transitions.

## Optional

- [Structural CSS](dist/structure.css): the CSS the library injects, for decks that set `injectStyles: false`.
- [Layout helpers](dist/layout.css): the `data-layout` helper CSS.
